title: Rav Acha son of Rav Ketina
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Yevamot 66a he relates a case of a woman who was half a maidservant, etc. The statement is repeated in Gittin 38a in the name of Rav Chanina son of Rav Ketina, and there at 43b in the name of Rav Huna bar Ketina. He is also mentioned in Zevachim 53a.

notes.text: The consulted passages name Acha in Yevamot and Zevachim, Chanina in Gittin 38a, and Huna in Gittin 43b. The two Gittin passages and the Yevamot passage report Rabbi Yitzchak.
